t: This is 54 Redington Road, a building in Camden designed by the architect C. H. B. Quennell. Quennell lived from 1872 to 1935 and was an architect, designer, illustrator and historian. A heritage architect, Cath Layton, says his great influence can be felt in the houses and streets of London's suburbs and across the country. This house is one small example of that suburban work. He also wrote books for children and young people that encouraged interest in history, so he was a man of many talents.
